name: SkinVision
summary: Mobile app that assesses the risk of a skin spot from a photo and advises whether and when to see a doctor. A risk assessment, not a diagnosis.
description: Mobile app that assesses the risk of a skin spot from a photo and advises whether and when to see a doctor. A risk assessment, not a diagnosis.

pricing.details: 3-month plan 24.99 € — unlimited skin-spot checks, risk assessments, body map and reminders, seasonal self-exam assistant. 12-month plan 49.99 € — same unlimited checks for one year. Single Check 6.99 € — one skin-spot check with a risk assessment and advice on seeing a doctor. No lasting 0 € plan was stated on the official site. Official prices already in euro, shown as published

Body map and reminders, plus a seasonal self-exam assistant on the unlimited plans
Personalised advice on whether and when to see a doctor — a risk assessment, not a diagnosis
Single Check or unlimited 3-month and 12-month plans.
